newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt brewery firm profits up in 1995/6.
newsitem.headline: Egypt brewery firm profits up in 1995/6.

text.p: Pyramids Breweries, also known as al-Ahram Beverages, made net after-tax profits of 42.980 million pounds in the financial year 1995/6, 35.8 percent up on 31.654 million in 1994/5, according to audited results available on Sunday.
Turnover rose to 130.100 million pounds, 11.0 percent up on 117.185 million in the previous year, and profits before tax were 59.810 million, 31.7 percent up on 45.408 million.

The state privatised about 15 percent of the company's 4.5 million shares in July. The government had planned to sell 20 percent of the firm's equity but religious opposition dampened the deal. The shares last traded on the Egyptian stock exchange at 67.00 pounds.
